title: Require close-out handoff in worker and execution skills
description:
Why this issue exists
The executing-plans and bead-worker skills instruct agents to validate and close beads, but they do not explicitly require the canonical close-out boundary: update Beads notes, run git status, report changed files and validation, capture follow-up work, then close only when acceptance criteria are met.

What needs to be done
Update plugins/gin-workflow/src/skills/executing-plans/SKILL.md and plugins/gin-workflow/src/skills/bead-worker/SKILL.md so both defer to docs/verification-and-handoff-workflow.md before closure. Make it clear that validation success alone is insufficient without handoff evidence and Beads outcome notes.
acceptance_criteria: executing-plans and bead-worker both reference the canonical verification-and-handoff workflow before closure. Both require git status and handoff evidence before bd close. Both explain that failed or incomplete validation leaves the bead in progress or blocked with notes.
notes: Updated executing-plans and bead-worker skills to defer closure to docs/verification-and-handoff-workflow.md, require Beads outcome notes plus git status and handoff evidence before bd close, and keep failed/incomplete work in progress or blocked with notes. Verified by targeted doc review and text checks.
close_reason: Completed

title: Prevent orchestrator closure before integration close-out
description:
Why this issue exists
The bead-orchestrator skill currently closes a bead when a worker finishes successfully, then performs worktree safety checks and integration afterward. This can mark durable Beads state as complete before integration, verification, handoff, and follow-up capture are actually done.

What needs to be done
Update the orchestrator guidance so worker success produces a ready-for-close result, but final bd close happens only after required safety checks, integration when in scope, verification evidence, handoff context, and follow-up work capture are complete. Align wording with docs/agent-task-lifecycle.md and docs/verification-and-handoff-workflow.md.
acceptance_criteria: bead-orchestrator does not instruct agents to close before integration or close-out checks. Closure wording explicitly follows verification-and-handoff workflow. Any integration failure leaves the bead active or blocked with notes rather than closed.
notes: Updated bead-orchestrator so worker success means ready for integration and close-out review, not immediate closure. Final bd close now depends on the canonical verification-and-handoff workflow, integration completion when in scope, Beads outcome notes, git status review, follow-up capture, and handoff evidence. Verified by targeted doc review and text checks.
close_reason: Completed
